Name: Items Have Weight
Author: BarleyZP
Description:
All items in-game have a different weight depending on their category! If you carry too much weight, you can't walk as fast. The more you have in your backpack, the harder it gets to carry it all...

Check out the source code on [url=https://github.com/lisyce/StardewValleyMods]Github[/url]﻿.
